note: Reviewed demonstration-asset registry. Status values follow docs/07: NOT_SELECTED -> SOURCE_FOUND -> LICENSE_VERIFIED -> DOWNLOADED -> CLIP_REVIEWED -> MOVEMENT_APPROVED -> TRANSCODED -> QA_PASSED -> PUBLISHED. An entry may only serve as a patient-facing demonstration once BOTH license_verified and movement_reviewed are true. Nothing in this file is publishable today. `ui_note` is the short Chinese sentence shown next to the diagram; `notes` is the developer audit text and is never rendered.

review_log.author: Taylor Shaw (Tcshaw427)
review_log.usable_for: Nothing patient-facing. Kept only as a documented review record.
reasons_zh: 素材中没有任何椅子。本站该动作只支持「站姿扶椅」，用自由站立的示范会让患者看到与实际任务不符的做法。
示范者双脚明显外旋成标准芭蕾第一位。动作定义并不要求外旋，给患者的提示是「双脚自然站立」。
示范的屈膝幅度属于中深蹲，超过了本动作要求的小幅屈膝范围。
全片约 12.6 秒中有 5 秒左右是标题卡与署名卡，不是动作画面。
示范者穿着深色宽松长裤，恰好遮住了本动作要测量的膝关节位置。
reasons_en_developer_note: No chair anywhere in the clip. Our Demi-Plié is supported standing only, so a free-standing demonstration misrepresents the task the patient is asked to do.
Clear turned-out ballet first position. The exercise definition explicitly does not require 180-degree turnout and the patient instructions say natural comfortable foot placement.
The plié shown is a moderate-to-deep bend, not the small range the definition asks for.
About 5 of the 12.6 seconds are title and attribution cards rather than movement.
The performer's legs are in dark loose trousers, which obscures knee position at the very joint the exercise measures.

review_log.author: Tcshaw427
reasons_zh: 素材站点对本机持续返回 429 限流，多次尝试均无法下载，因此尚未观看过这段视频。
没有看过就不能算审核通过。升级包本身也只把它列为候选。
reasons_en_developer_note: Wikimedia returned HTTP 429 (bot traffic throttle) on every attempt across several sessions, and plain curl was reset at the TLS handshake. The file could not be obtained, so it has not been watched.
Not reviewed means not approved. The package itself flags it as a candidate only.

reasons_en_developer_note: A 3D animation, not a filmed person. docs/04 rules it out as a chair-supported demonstration for patients; if ever referenced it must be labelled as an animation.
